summary_en: Shin-Etsu Chemical completed post-adjustment for its commitment-type self-share acquisition (FCSR) program. Adjustment period ② resulted in a net reduction of 478,700 shares. Combined with adjustment period ①, total acquired shares reached 33,552,100, with the average acquisition price of 5,862.92 yen determined by VWAP from July 31 to November 6, 2026, adjusted by 97.984% plus dividend adjustment of 17.08 yen.
title_en: Notification of Completion of Post-Adjustment in Commitment-Type Self-Share Acquisition (FCSR)
translation_en_brief:
Shin-Etsu Chemical announced the completion of post-adjustment for its commitment-type self-share acquisition (FCSR) program on November 9, 2026. The company had initiated this program on July 24, 2026, utilizing ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trading with Nomura Securities.

For adjustment period ②, the post-adjustment process determined a final acquisition of 16,231,700 shares against a calculated benchmark of 15,752,963 shares based on average price, resulting in a net reduction adjustment of 478,700 shares. The average acquisition price for the entire FCSR program was fixed at 5,862.92 yen, calculated as the arithmetic mean of daily volume-weighted average prices (VWAP) from July 31 to November 6, 2026, multiplied by 97.984%, plus a dividend adjustment of 17.08 yen per share.

Combining both adjustment periods, the total acquired shares reached 33,552,100, including 2,209,000 shares acquired from sources other than Nomura Securities. The adjustment mechanism employed warrant conversion, with excess shares allocable to warrant holders. This completion represents the final determination of share count and price terms under the FCSR framework.
